source: Operator statement after exercising the running 0.3.0 build against the live estate
statement: The operator tested the 0.3.0 Explorer and reported it working well, stating full user acceptance and asking to proceed to publication.
scope: Human product, usability, visual and accessibility dispositions for the 0.3.0 interface increment, including the six requirements it introduced, exercised against the operator's own estate through the local service.

carried_from.basis: Behaviour unchanged by this increment, so the 2026-08-27 disposition still describes what the operator accepted.

not_yet_dispositioned_at_0_3_0.reason: The Windows installation, launch and upgrade journeys were exercised on the 0.2.0 installed application. No 0.3.0 installer existed at the time of this statement, so the operator's acceptance is not extended to them.

notes: Technical dispositions remain owned by the executable evidence suite. The Windows lifecycle remains blocked at the signing gate and is unaffected by this acceptance.
